Name: Garden Pot Options
Author: ncarigon
Description:
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14820?tab=description]Garden Pot Tweaks[/url], this mod implements many features from that mod into Stardew Valley 1.6, namely:

[list=1]
[*]Ability to pick up and place down garden pots while keeping their content[s];[/s]
[*][b]*New in version 1.0.1*[/b] Choose which tool can safely pick up garden pots - [u][b]Default is Pickaxe[/b][/u]
[*]Allow sprinklers to water garden pots;
[*]Allow ancient seeds to be planted in garden pots - [b][u]Not enabled by default[/u][/b].
[*][b]*New in version 1.0.3*[/b] Transplant crops and bushes using garden pots. Just scoop them up with an empty garden pot, then place crops in another empty hoed dirt spot and bushes in an empty (non-hoed) spot.
[*][b]*New in version 1.0.4*[/b] Configurable Evelyn heart events to allow for early garden pot access.
[*][b]*New in version 1.0.5*[/b] Ability to transplant trees and fruit trees, with configurable size options.
[/list]
I did not reimplement the bee house features since those are handled by newer mods such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10996]Better Beehouses[/url]. I also did not reimplement the item drawing for garden pots while in menu or being carried, since that is more advanced and not strictly needed for overall functionality. I might revisit that later.

Source: [url=https://github.com/ncarigon/StardewValleyMods]ncarigon/StardewValleyMods (github.com)[/url]
